---
title: "Research"
---

My work sits at the intersection of **assistive robotics** and **physical
human-robot interaction**: designing sensor-driven systems that infer what a
person intends to do — from a gait mode to a sit-to-stand transition — and
turning that inference into safe, adaptive robotic assistance in real time.

**Keywords:** Wearable Robotics · Assistive Robotics · Multimodal Learning · Nonlinear Control

## Professional Experience {.section-title}

::: {.timeline}

::: {.timeline-item}
<div class="timeline-date">Jul 2026 – Present</div>
### Postdoctoral Researcher
<div class="org">Université Paris-Est Créteil, Vitry-sur-Seine, France</div>
- Designed a high-precision gait mode recognition system using LSTM networks,
  achieving **98% classification accuracy** and enabling real-time intent
  detection for actuated ankle-foot orthoses.
- Developed an energy-efficient adaptive FES control strategy based on surface
  EMG signals, **reducing stimulation energy consumption by 30%** while
  significantly mitigating muscle fatigue in clinical trials.
- Implemented a multi-sensor fusion framework (7 IMUs) to extract kinematic
  metrics for lower-limb joint analysis and Parkinson's disease diagnosis in a
  portable clinical device.
:::
